zh: 修复账户状态流按旧帧结构读取、把已登录账户判成未登录，从而导致账户区不取 DeepSeek 账户昵称而显示 Windows 用户名的问题；同时已登录账户不再退回机器用户名，资料里没有名字时显示宿主自己的账户标签
en: Fix the account stream being read as the state itself instead of the host's { type, state } frames, which judged a signed-in account as signed out and left the account area on the Windows user name instead of the DeepSeek account's nickname; a signed-in account also no longer falls back to the machine's user name, showing the host's own account label when the profile carries no name
